Implemented the feature contract in django/contrib/admin/options.py.

Change: In `ModelAdmin.changelist_view`, the list_editable POST processing loop (which saves forms, related objects, and change logs) is now wrapped in `transaction.atomic(using=router.db_for_write(self.model))`. This ensures that if any error occurs while processing bulk edits, the database is not left in an unexpected partial state. `transaction` and `router` were already imported.

Verification: scoped_tests public regression selection (admin_changelist) passed — 74 tests ran, 0 failures.
